_comment: The enabled service surface of a project, against the surface the profile declares.
Shaped so the demo shows both directions the check grades. run.googleapis.com and
secretmanager.googleapis.com are enabled and declared, so they pass. aiplatform is enabled
and undeclared — functionality nobody defined, which fails. dataflow is declared and not
enabled, which warns: the definition describes an estate that is not running, and that is a
stale document rather than an exposure.
The baseline services a project always carries are filtered by the collector rather than
listed here, because enabling them was never a decision anyone made.
